name: A Berlin courtyard

place_source.title: Wikidata: Berlin (Q64), coordinate location and elevation above sea level

blurb: The interior courtyard of a Berlin tenement block: brick walls on all sides, a cobbled square, a lime and a plane at the edges, clipped yew and thuja along the walls, and a patch of toadspawn in the rain butt. Tits, robins and wrens work the shrubs by day, wood pigeons and magpies hold the high ground, and foxes, hedgehogs and wood mice come out after dark.
